{
  "evidence": [
    {
      "ref_id": "p001",
      "group_ids": [
        "W1",
        "W5"
      ],
      "quote": "CanSinoBIO has established a comprehensive welfare support system for full-time employees, part-time personnel, and outsourced personnel. The Company strictly ensures that all employees are entitled to statutory benefits, including social insurance and the housing fund, annual leave, and sick leave, so that every employee receives consistent care and protection. On this basis, the Company has introduced a range of non-statutory benefits and care programs covering multiple areas. In 2025, the total value of employee benefits distributed by the Company amounted to RMB 73.12 million.",
      "kind": "policy/mechanism/result",
      "period": "January 1, 2025, to December 31, 2025",
      "scope": "full-time employees, part-time personnel, and outsourced personnel",
      "relevance": "Discloses statutory benefits (social insurance, housing fund) and confirms actual distribution of benefits in 2025."
    },
    {
      "ref_id": "p003",
      "group_ids": [
        "W2",
        "W3",
        "W4"
      ],
      "quote": "The Company provides employees with commercial insurance coverage above the market average and also offers medical insurance and free vaccinations for employees' children.",
      "kind": "mechanism/action",
      "period": "January 1, 2025, to December 31, 2025",
      "scope": "employees and their children",
      "relevance": "Discloses supplementary benefit (commercial insurance) and family support (medical insurance/vaccinations for children), specifying the applicable subjects."
    },
    {
      "ref_id": "p004",
      "group_ids": [
        "W2",
        "W4"
      ],
      "quote": "The Company provides full-time employees with nonstatutory leave benefits, including company annual leave and fully paid sick leave, and in certain regions applies the more favorable standard for marriage leave and paternity leave.",
      "kind": "mechanism/policy",
      "period": "January 1, 2025, to December 31, 2025",
      "scope": "full-time employees; certain regions for marriage/paternity leave",
      "relevance": "Discloses specific non-statutory leave benefits and defines eligibility rules (full-time status, regional standards)."
    },
    {
      "ref_id": "p005",
      "group_ids": [
        "W3",
        "W4"
      ],
      "quote": "The Company has established a 24/7 psychological support hotline and launched EAP psychological courses to safeguard employees' mental health.",
      "kind": "action/mechanism",
      "period": "January 1, 2025, to December 31, 2025",
      "scope": "employees",
      "relevance": "Discloses family/life support resources (psychological hotline, EAP) available to employees."
    },
    {
      "ref_id": "p006",
      "group_ids": [
        "W2",
        "W3",
        "W4",
        "W5"
      ],
      "quote": "The Company also provides assistance to employees in financial hardship by granting monthly subsidies to eligible employees and offers home visits and condolence payments to employees suffering from serious illness.",
      "kind": "action/result",
      "period": "January 1, 2025, to December 31, 2025",
      "scope": "eligible employees in financial hardship; employees with serious illness",
      "relevance": "Discloses supplementary welfare (subsidies, condolence payments) and life support (home visits), with specific eligibility criteria ('eligible', 'suffering from') and implies ongoing provision ('granting')."
    },
    {
      "ref_id": "p015",
      "group_ids": [
        "W2",
        "W4"
      ],
      "quote": "The Company has optimized the points circulation and claims functions of its flexible benefits platform to enhance employees' experience in selecting benefit plans and products.",
      "kind": "mechanism",
      "period": "January 1, 2025, to December 31, 2025",
      "scope": "employees",
      "relevance": "Discloses a flexible benefits platform mechanism allowing employees to select plans/products, indicating acquisition rules via points/claims."
    },
    {
      "ref_id": "p017",
      "group_ids": [
        "W2",
        "W4",
        "W5"
      ],
      "quote": "At the same time, the Company continued to provide employees with a range of allowances, including off-site work assignment allowances, overseas hardship project allowances, and position-based allowances.",
      "kind": "action/result",
      "period": "January 1, 2025, to December 31, 2025",
      "scope": "employees receiving specific allowances",
      "relevance": "Discloses specific supplementary allowances (off-site, overseas, position-based) and confirms they were provided ('continued to provide')."
